# Sportskeeda

> > Sportskeeda is a comprehensive sports media platform covering cricket, WWE/AEW wrestling, football, Formula 1, tennis, baseball, esports, and entertainment with news, match predictions, schedules, and betting tips.

Sportskeeda provides extensive coverage of major sporting events including IPL 2026, T20 World Cup, World Baseball Classic, and WWE/AEW wrestling storylines. The site features match previews, betting predictions, player profiles, tournament schedules, and breaking news across multiple sports and entertainment verticals.
